{{Otheruses|Sector Chief}}
The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] utilized the rank of '''sector chief''' in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. [[Doshao]], [[Sata'ak]], [[Harmae]] and [[Tugorn]] were all [[Escalation|escalated]] to the rank of sector chief that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].
